A '''sky fortress''' was located in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pirdia]], but was long abandoned by the [[Time/Legends|time]] gas miners rediscovered it during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Sky Fortress}}</ref>
